comment: I’m off to an undesirable start in Segment 3, so it’s time to be aggressive so that decisions that I’ll be making in the FedExCup Playoffs will matter. However, with no cut, it’s going to need to be the guys surrounding captain Scheffler who will need to step up.

expert_title: Senior Manager, TOUR & Golfbet Editorial & Distribution
comment: My decision to sit Scottie Scheffler last week paid off for 36 holes, but not 72. Here’s hoping I can max one of my remaining starts with him on a week where everyone will go low.
I am burning one of three starts in an event where he can fire at flags and rack up birdies. After missing the cut with my captain last week, I will enjoy not stressing with the Texan.
I’ve already used Scheffler once. So roster management will be all about picking a captain I think can rack up the points/birdies.
Continues to play well and nearly won here a year ago. He gets redemption this week.
The golf Burns displayed down the stretch at Shinnecock was the best he’s had in his career. Looking for those birdie putts to keep falling in droves this week.
